title: Metropolitan Commercial Bank Recognized as a Member of Piper Sandler’s Sm-All Stars Class of 2024
summary: The Prestigious Award Highlights the Bank’s Commitment to Excellence and Innovation Metropolitan Bank Holding Corp. (the “Company”) (NYSE: MCB), the holding company for Metropolitan Commercial Bank is pleased to announce its recognition as a member of Piper Sandler’s Sm-All Stars Class of 2024.
